    scenarios_by_key, gaps_by_key = {}, {}
    for analysis in boundary_analyses:
        for scenario in analysis.get("scenarios") or []:
            module = str(scenario.get("module") or "未标注模块").strip()
            name = str(scenario.get("scenario") or "未归纳场景").strip()
            key = (module, name)
            merged = scenarios_by_key.setdefault(key, {
                "module": module, "scenario": name, "priority": scenario.get("priority") or "未知",
                "cases": {axis: [] for axis in axes}, "exemptions": {},
            })
            for axis in axes:
                values = (scenario.get("cases") or {}).get(axis) or []
                if isinstance(values, str):
                    values = [values] if values.strip() else []
                merged["cases"][axis].extend(str(value) for value in values if str(value).strip())
            merged["exemptions"].update(scenario.get("exemptions") or {})
        for gap in analysis.get("gaps") or []:
            key = tuple(str(gap.get(field) or "") for field in ("module", "scenario", "axis"))
            if key[2]:
                gaps_by_key.setdefault(key, gap)
    # 兜底核对矩阵与缺口清单一致：模型漏列缺口时仍明确展示，不能让 ✗ 消失在建议表外。
    for (module, scenario), data in scenarios_by_key.items():
        for axis in axes:
            if data["cases"][axis] or data["exemptions"].get(axis):
                continue
            key = (module, scenario, axis)
            if key not in gaps_by_key:
                priority = str(data.get("priority") or "").upper()
                grade = "必补" if any(token in priority for token in ("P0", "P1", "高", "核心")) and axis in axes[:4] else "建议补"
                gaps_by_key[key] = {
                    "grade": grade,
                    "reason": "未找到可追溯的支持用例；模型未提供更具体的缺口依据。",
                    "suggestion": "评估是否需要在方案/用例中补充该角度；未知业务规则需先确认。",
                    "test_point": "【待业务确认】依据已确认规则定义可执行输入与可观察结果。",
                }
    boundary.merge_cells("A1:K1")

    boundary["A2"] = "只审不建。本次未提供独立测试方案，无法核验方案备注及方案-用例追溯；覆盖仅依据输入用例。✓列出支持用例，✗为缺口，—仅用于有明确依据的不适用项。"
    boundary.append([])
    boundary.append(["覆盖概况", "值", "说明"])
    covered_count = sum(bool(data["cases"][axis]) and not data["exemptions"].get(axis)
                        for data in scenarios_by_key.values() for axis in axes)
    gap_count = len(gaps_by_key)
    applicable_count = sum(1 for data in scenarios_by_key.values() for axis in axes if not data["exemptions"].get(axis))
    boundary.append(["场景数", len(scenarios_by_key), "按模块与用例名称归并"])
    boundary.append(["核查格子", applicable_count, "七个固定角度；明确豁免不计入分母"])
    boundary.append(["已覆盖格子", covered_count, "仅统计模型列出的输入用例"])
    boundary.append(["覆盖率", "=IF(B6=0,0,B7/B6)", "已覆盖格子 / 核查格子；基于用例输入的估算"])
    boundary.append(["缺口数", gap_count, "缺口明细见下表"])
    boundary.append(["结论", "未提供测试方案；结果为降级审查", "不据此判定方案备注合规或追溯闭环"])
    boundary.append([])
    boundary.append(["模块", "场景", "原优先级", *axes])
    matrix_header = boundary.max_row
    for data in scenarios_by_key.values():
        row = [data["module"], data["scenario"], data["priority"]]
        for axis in axes:
            cases = list(dict.fromkeys(data["cases"][axis]))
            exemption = data["exemptions"].get(axis)
            row.append(("✓ " + "、".join(cases)) if cases else ("— " + str(exemption) if exemption else "✗"))
        boundary.append(row)
    boundary.append([])
    boundary.append(["缺口编号", "模块", "场景", "缺失角度", "分级", "判定依据", "回写建议", "建议测试要点"])
    gap_header = boundary.max_row
    for (module, scenario, axis), gap in gaps_by_key.items():
        boundary.append([gap.get("gap_id", ""), module, scenario, axis, gap.get("grade", "建议补"),
                         gap.get("reason", ""), gap.get("suggestion", ""), gap.get("test_point", "")])
    boundary.append([])
    boundary.append(["分析结论", "；".join(dict.fromkeys(str(item.get("conclusion")) for item in boundary_analyses if item.get("conclusion"))) or "未返回结论"])

    confirmation_sheet = workbook.create_sheet("测试确认处理结果")
    confirmation_sheet.merge_cells("A1:F1")
